annotations.title: Check remembered claims against their sources

description: check_quote over a batch, for auditing what an agent wrote down earlier. Give it up to 10 remembered claims, each with the source it is attributed to, and it returns the same verdict and receipt for every one: FOUND, CLOSE MATCH, DISTILLED MATCH, NOT FOUND or CAN'T ESTABLISH, with where, the speaker and the class of that claim, the passage, which representation was read and how much of it, and when. Reach for it when a note, a memory store or a shared workspace has accumulated claims nobody re-checked, and you want the ones no source supports. The summary counts verdicts and lists the claims that came back NOT FOUND; it is deliberately not a score, a percentage or a trust rating, because a NOT FOUND is bounded to the representation Yank read and is never a claim that the words were not said. A claim whose source is audio Yank would have to transcribe returns CAN'T ESTABLISH rather than being paid for. No model is consulted anywhere in this: every verdict resolves against the representation itself, and none of them is a judgement on whether a claim is true.

claims.description: The remembered claims to check, up to 10 per call. Each one is checked against its own source.

id.description: Optional. Your own identifier for this claim, echoed back so you can match the verdict to the note it came from.

source.description: The public http(s) link the claim is attributed to.

statement.description: The remembered words, as written down. Up to 600 characters.
